title: Nose-Tingling Roast Kenyan Mushrooms Roast
description: A flavorful and aromatic Kenyan-inspired dish featuring roasted oyster mushrooms, traditionally served as a breakfast or brunch option. This low-sodium recipe is a twist on the classic Kenyan shaggy mushroom dish.
instructions: Trim the stems of the oyster mushrooms and slice them into thin pieces.
In a large bowl, whisk together the melted coconut oil, chopped onion, grated ginger, tomato paste, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the bowl and toss them to coat them evenly with the marinade.
Transfer the mushroom mixture to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the mushrooms in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
After 20 minutes, remove the baking sheet from the oven and garnish the mushrooms with chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley or cilantro.
Return the baking sheet to the oven and roast for an additional 5-10 minutes, until the mushrooms are tender and caramelized.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and let the mushrooms rest for a few minutes before serving.
